title: ItemToChat
description: Simple common mod that allows you to show held item in chat via [i] when typed
body:
Adds a simple [i] chat tag that lets players show their held item in chat. Hover to see full details. Lightweight, server friendly, and works with Forge 1.16.5. No commands needed, just type and show your item.

Any bugs/crashes message me on discord @skyxei.
